# function: wisdom_message_template

Builds the ARN for `wisdom` `MessageTemplate`:

```
arn:${Partition}:wisdom:${Region}:${Account}:message-template/${KnowledgeBaseId}/${MessageTemplateId}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:wisdom:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:message-template/knowledge-base-id/message-template-id
output "wisdom_message_template" {
  value = provider::arn::wisdom_message_template("knowledge-base-id", "message-template-id")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
wisdom_message_template(knowledge_base_id string, message_template_id string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `knowledge_base_id` (String) Value for `${KnowledgeBaseId}` in the ARN template.
1. `message_template_id` (String) Value for `${MessageTemplateId}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
